turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why did Owen find out about a zero from his phone, in the middle of class?
Finish, then. But I'll want an answer to my question.
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
Cross-examined. I asked one question, and you haven't answered it.
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then answer it across a desk. Who entered the zero, and was anyone told before Owen saw it?
